items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I was also doing the same thing with Eric Clapton with John Mayall’s Blues Breakers records

ctx.x: Yeah. Who were the L.A. studio players who were representing the west coast, the L.A. jazz scene. I guess that record would have been made early 60s. Howard Roberts on guitar. And I’d slow the record down and try and figure out the licks. And then I discovered Django Reinhardt. But I was also doing the same thing with Eric Clapton with John Mayall’s Blues Breakers records and Jimi Hendrix. And I had a little band with some friends of mine and we’d get together once a week and whatever the new Who single or the…
And you learned it by playing the record, right?
